name: AgentGuard
desc: Make agent tool calls subject to explicit policies, limits and inspectable audit records.
focus: Policy evaluation for agent tool calls
note: Rate limits and audit scope depend on the implementation and deployment. A demonstration endpoint does not establish production security.
use: Start with the boundaries around what your agents can do. Review policies and audit behavior before connecting privileged tools.

name: FoundationCentar
desc: Explore governance-first foundations for operational AI deployment and accountability.
note: Deployment architecture and integrations require project-level validation. This preview does not connect to an orchestrator.
use: Use governance as the starting point for coordinating agents, defining ownership and planning human review.

name: Enterprise Hybrid-RAG
icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" aria-hidden="true"><ellipse cx="16" cy="7" rx="11" ry="4"/><path d="M5 7v18c0 6 22 6 22 0V7M5 16c0 6 22 6 22 0"/></svg>
desc: Connect enterprise knowledge with hybrid lexical and dense retrieval, fused through RRF.
note: Retrieval quality depends on your documents, indexing and evaluation. No performance or answer-accuracy benchmark is asserted here.
use: Start with your knowledge sources. Compare lexical and semantic retrieval against representative questions before choosing your configuration.

name: Agent Eval
icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 4v24h25M9 21v-7m7 7V8m7 13v-11"/><circle cx="24" cy="6" r="3"/></svg>
desc: Make agentic workflows easier to inspect through evidence-driven metrics and execution assessment.
note: Published evaluation tooling does not certify model correctness. Test coverage, datasets and acceptance thresholds need to fit your use case.
use: Define what good performance means, assemble representative tasks and inspect failures before increasing agent autonomy.

name: AgentVault
icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="5" y="12" width="22" height="17" rx="2"/><path d="M10 12V8a6 6 0 0 1 12 0v4M16 19v5"/><circle cx="16" cy="19" r="1"/></svg>
desc: Bring tool registration, secret management and bounded execution into a clearer control layer.
note: Secret handling and access isolation must be reviewed in the target environment. This website stores no secrets and runs no agent tools.
use: Review how tools are registered, credentials are handled and execution boundaries are enforced across your agent environment.

name: Pharma Intelligence OS
desc: Explore a dedicated workspace for pharmacovigilance and regulatory intelligence workflows.
note: Software demonstration only. Not medical advice, a validated regulatory submission system or an autonomous clinical decision tool. Human verification is required.
use: Explore how case review and regulatory evidence can be organized, while keeping qualified human review central to every consequential decision.
